title: High-resolution ALMA Observations of HD 100546: Asymmetric Circumstellar Ring and Circumplanetary Disk Upper Limits
question: What is the dust ring structure of the HD 100546 disk at ~4 au resolution, and can compact circumplanetary disk emission be detected at the claimed protoplanet positions?

what.value: Disk inclination and position angle for deprojection

evidence.quote: using the position angle and disk inclination parameters obtained by (cite: Pineda2014)

what.value: Radiative transfer dust temperature profile; T_d,mean=53 K

evidence.quote: with an average temperature of $T_{d,mean}=$53 K between 20 and 50 au

what.value: Teff=9800 K and stellar accretion rate
APEX CO total flux 191 Jy km/s

evidence.quote: reported by (cite: Panic_2009-Disk_Models) using APEX of 191 Jy km s$^{-1}$

recipe.method: PHOENIX photosphere scaled to Gaia distance and compared with Siess PMS tracks
CASA multiscale clean; natural and Briggs 0.5 continuum; uvcontsub CO cube; Keplerian-mask moment maps
Two concentric Gaussian rings + central Gaussian + vortex sampled on observed visibilities with GALARIO
Beam-wide strips along major axis and vortex maximum fitted with 5 Gaussians
3-sigma limit on point-like flux converted to mass (optically thin) and radius (optically thick)
assumptions: Distance 110.02 pc; dust temperature 53 K (932 K alternative)

recipe.goal: Planet mass and inner disk mass
recipe.method: Szulagyi 2017 CPD-CSD-planet relation; inner disk mass from the same opacity equation at 300 K

answer_key.quantity: 3-sigma point source limit at planet positions

evidence.quote: we determine the CPD (dust and gas) mass upper limit in the optically thin case to be 1.44 $M_{\ensuremath{\oplus}}$

answer_key.quantity: CPD radius upper limit (optically thick, 53 K)

evidence.quote: An upper limit for the CPD radius of 0.44 au is obtained

answer_key.quantity: Planet mass upper limit from CPD-CSD relation

evidence.quote: we place a planetary mass upper limit of 1.65 $M_J$
The total flux of the integrated intensity CO cube is 190 Jy km s$^{-1}$
